record.field: Functional: Contacts, Invoicing, CRM, Email Marketing
No code: import the donors, create the donation products, follow the patrons, thank everybody and invoice the donations.

field.name: description
field.p: Les Restos du Quartier is a food aid association: volunteers collect food and serve meals in the neighbourhood, thanks to donors and patrons. Until now, everything was managed with spreadsheets and emails: help them move to Odoo.
No code in this challenge: everything is done in the interface of Odoo, on your Odoo.sh database.

ol.li: The donors (Contacts): import the file donors.csv (10 donors, among which the company Boulangerie Kremer and its 2 contacts), then tag them: Donateur for everybody, Bénévole for Élise Bernard and Marc Kieffer, Entreprise for the bakery.
The products (Invoicing): two services in a product category Dons: Don libre, and Cotisation membre sold 25.
The patrons (CRM): a sales team Mécénat with its pipeline of 4 stages, Identifié, Contacté, Dossier envoyé and Signé, and 3 opportunities, one of them won.
Thank you! (Email Marketing): a mailing list Donateurs with the 10 donors (tip: from the list of the contacts, Actions › Add to Mailing List), and a thank-you mailing sent to this list.

The donations (Invoicing): confirm 3 invoices of donations or fees to donors, then analyse the invoices by donor in a pivot view (Invoicing › Reporting › Management › Invoice Analysis, grouped by Partner) and save this analysis in your favorites (Save search, in the menu of the search bar).

field.p: ⭐ Bonus: a field N° d'entreprise (company number) on the contacts, created with Studio; a 0 % tax on the two products; an activity planned on an opportunity of the patrons; the mailing really processed (on a test database, run the scheduled action Mail Marketing: Process queue manually); a donation paid.
